insights.headline: Overall headline conversion rate is 0.71% across 1 million visitor sessions
insights.detail: The platform recorded 1,000,000 unique destination card clicks and 7,054 completed purchases, yielding an overall headline conversion rate of 0.71% over the observed time window.
insights.why: Establishes the core platform baseline for visitor-to-purchase volume against which deeper funnel stages and drop-offs are measured.
insights.recommendation: Track daily variations against this 0.71% baseline when deploying new funnel updates or marketing campaigns.

insights.headline: Daily destination card clicks exhibit consistent periodic volume fluctuations between 3,600 and 4,800 clicks
insights.detail: Daily unique user clicks on destination cards range from a low of 3,689 on January 7, 2026, to a peak of 4,783 on January 15, 2026, showing regular cyclical dips every 6 to 7 days.
insights.why: Reflects standard weekly seasonality in travel intent and browsing patterns rather than systemic technical interruptions.
insights.recommendation: Account for weekly cyclicality when evaluating short-term campaign performance or traffic dips.

insights.headline: The steepest funnel drop-off occurs between destination card clicks and application starts
insights.detail: Out of 1,000,000 initial destination card clicks, only 154,413 users proceed to start an application (a step-through rate of 15.4%), representing an absolute loss of 845,587 users.
insights.why: Users browse destination requirements or card info casually without high immediate intent to apply, which is inherent to the discovery phase of a travel platform.
insights.recommendation: Focus optimization efforts on high-intent entry points and explore re-engagement mechanics like the WhatsApp nudge to capture browsing drop-offs.

insights.headline: Android passport upload pass rates underperform iOS by up to 8 percentage points
insights.detail: Android camera uploads achieve an 83.6% pass rate with 0.47 average retries compared to 91.3% pass rate and 0.46 average retries on iOS camera uploads across 9,598 total document uploads.
insights.why: Coincides with the documented April 2026 passport scan model update which introduced higher capture failure rates across Android devices.
insights.recommendation: Review the Android passport capture model weights and error thresholds deployed in April 2026 to reduce scan failures.

insights.headline: Android users in Singapore and Great Britain experience the highest passport capture threshold failure rates
insights.detail: Android users in Singapore (SG) experience a 22.2% failure rate crossing the failed-attempt threshold (20 failures out of 90 uploads), while Great Britain (GB) Android users see an 18.2% failure rate.
insights.why: Amplified by a combination of the Android passport scan model update and potential higher prevalence of non-Latin MRZ or local document variations in international hubs.
context_refs: K3 MRZ OCR weaker on non-Latin passports
insights.recommendation: Audit passport capture logs for Singapore and GB Android traffic to isolate whether device model or document type drives the elevated threshold failures.

queries.question: What is the overall headline conversion rate measured as completed purchases per unique session, alongside total event counts across the core funnel stages?
queries.sql: SELECT uniqExact(app_session_id) AS total_sessions, (SELECT uniqExact(app_session_id) FROM atlys.purchase_completed) AS total_purchases, (SELECT uniqExact(app_session_id) FROM atlys.purchase_completed) / nullIf(uniqExact(app_session_id), 0) AS overall_conversion_rate FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked

queries.question: What is the daily trend of destination card clicks and completed purchases over time?
queries.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS dt, uniqExact(user_id) AS destination_clicks FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the step-through conversion rate and drop-off per funnel stage across different device types?
queries.sql: SELECT device_type, uniqExact(user_id) AS clicks FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the destination card click and purchase volume broken down by geographic country code?
queries.sql: SELECT geoip_country_code, uniqExact(user_id) AS unique_visitors, count() AS total_clicks FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked GROUP BY geoip_country_code ORDER BY total_clicks DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the step-to-step user count and conversion ratio across the sequential funnel stages from destination click to purchase completion?
queries.sql: SELECT '1_click' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked UNION ALL SELECT '2_app_started' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.application_started UNION ALL SELECT '3_doc_uploaded' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.document_uploaded UNION ALL SELECT '4_purchase_completed' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.purchase_completed

queries.question: What is the passport-capture pass rate and average retry count broken down by device OS and capture mode?
queries.sql: SELECT os, capture_mode, count() AS total_uploads, countIf(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 0) / count() AS pass_rate, avg(retry_count) AS avg_retries FROM atlys.document_uploaded GROUP BY os, capture_mode ORDER BY total_uploads DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What cross-dimensional anomaly patterns exist between device types and geographic countries regarding failed passport capture attempts?
queries.sql: SELECT device_type, geoip_country_code, count() AS uploads, countIf(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 1) AS failed_threshold_count, countIf(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 1) / count() AS failure_rate FROM atlys.document_uploaded GROUP BY device_type, geoip_country_code HAVING uploads > 5 ORDER BY failure_rate DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the distribution of retry counts during document uploads across different devices and operating systems using quantiles?
queries.sql: SELECT device_type, os, quantile(0.5)(retry_count) AS p50_retries, quantile(0.95)(retry_count) AS p95_retries FROM atlys.document_uploaded GROUP BY device_type, os ORDER BY p95_retries DESC LIMIT 20

observations.input:
# Business context first (context v1)

Read this before the query results; it defines what matters and which anomalies are already explained.

# Metric definitions

```json
[
  {
    "key": "Conversion rate",
    "value": "completed purchases \u00f7 **sessions**. A session is a single app-open / web visit. This is the headline number reported to leadership."
  },
  {
    "key": "Drop-off rate (per funnel stage)",
    "value": "1 \u2212 (users at stage N+1 \u00f7 users at stage N), counting distinct `user_id` reaching each stage in order within the window."
  },
  {
    "key": "On-time delivery rate",
    "value": "applications issued on or before `visa_issuance_eta_days` \u00f7 applications issued. (Reported by the fulfilment team from post-purchase systems; not computable from the funnel tables here.)"
  },
  {
    "key": "Passport-capture pass rate",
    "value": "document uploads that did **not** cross the failed-capture threshold (`is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 0`) \u00f7 document uploads."
  },
  {
    "key": "Revenue per conversion",
    "value": "`value` on `purchase_completed`, in the event's `currency`."
  },
  {
    "key": "Step-through rate",
    "value": "users at stage N+1 \u00f7 users at stage N."
  },
  {
    "key": "section:4. Metric definitions",
    "value": "> Note on funnel conversion: within the funnel, we treat **conversion as\n> `purchase_completed` users \u00f7 users who started an application**\n> (`application_started`). This is the denominator used in the drop-off dashboards.\n\n---"
  }
]
```

# Business definitions

```json
[
  {
    "key": "section:1. Business overview",
    "value": "Atlys is a digital visa platform. Travellers discover visa requirements for a\ndestination, start an application, upload their passport, and pay. The product's\nnorth-star is **conversion**: turning a visitor who taps a destination card into a\npaid application, with as little drop-off as possible acro"
  },
  {
    "key": "section:7. How to analyse the funnel",
    "value": "- Compute step counts as `uniq(user_id)` (or `application_id` past application start)\n  per stage, in `timestamp` order, over a time window. Prefer\n  `windowFunnel`/`sequenceMatch` over per-table row dumps.\n- Always cut by at least device, geo, and destination before concluding.\n- Push aggregation i"
  },
  {
    "key": "section:Atlys Analytics \u2014 Base Context Layer",
    "value": "> This is the shared business + data context for the analytics agents. It describes\n> what Atlys does, the conversion funnel we optimise, the events we capture, the\n> metrics we track, and the quirks we already know about. Treat it as the starting\n> point, not gospel: it is maintained by hand and ca"
  }
]
```

# Known issues log

```json
[
  {
    "key": "K1",
    "value": "iOS WebKit OTP autofill regression.** On recent iOS builds the payment OTP field fails to autofill, and some users abandon at the pay step. Payment-heavy geos (Gulf card users) are most exposed. Watch `pay_now_clicked \u2192 purchase_completed` for iOS."
  },
  {
    "key": "K2",
    "value": "Passport scan model update (Apr 2026).** The on-device passport model was updated in early April. Some Android devices report more capture failures since; being monitored."
  },
  {
    "key": "K3",
    "value": "MRZ OCR weaker on non-Latin passports.** Passports with non-Latin machine-readable zones need more capture retries."
  },
  {
    "key": "K4",
    "value": "Schengen summer slot scarcity (Apr\u2013Jun).** Appointment slots for Schengen destinations are scarce in summer; expect seasonal softness, not a bug."
  },
  {
    "key": "K5",
    "value": "WhatsApp nudge launch (Feb 2026).** A WhatsApp re-engagement nudge went live in February; it can lift returns to the funnel for previously-dropped users."
  },
  {
    "key": "K6",
    "value": "SUMMER20 coupon campaign.** A `SUMMER20` promo ran in Q2; expect elevated `coupon_applied` and lower realised `value`."
  },
  {
    "key": "K7",
    "value": "App 7.45 rollout.** App version 7.45.x rolled out mid-quarter; minor funnel-timing shifts around the rollout are expected."
  },
  {
    "key": "section:5. Known-issues log",
    "value": "---"
  }
]
```
Check every anomaly against this before inventing an explanation.

# Context problems found

```json
[
  {
    "kind": "contradiction",
    "severity": "high",
    "subject": "relationship:shared application_id",
    "detail": "The relationship states that pre-application events like `destination_card_clicked` share an `application_id`, but the Application entity definition explicitly states that application_id is created at the `application_started` step and that events *before* it carry an empty `application_id`."
  },
  {
    "kind": "gap",
    "severity": "high",
    "subject": "metric:Revenue per conversion",
    "detail": "metric is named but has no executable formula or denominator"
  },
  {
    "kind": "gap",
    "severity": "high",
    "subject": "known_issue:K2",
    "detail": "K2 mentions a passport scan model update in April 2026 and related capture failures on Android devices, but states no specific time window or affected segment boundaries (beyond generic Android devices) to filter out or isolate the anomaly."
  },
  {
    "kind": "gap",
    "severity": "high",
    "subject": "known_issue:K3",
    "detail": "K3 notes that MRZ OCR is weaker on non-Latin passports and requires more retries, but lacks a stated time window, segment identifier, or filtering criteria to evaluate its impact on pass rates."
  }
]
```

output.summary: Overall headline conversion rate stands at 0.71% based on 1M destination card clicks and 7,054 purchases. The funnel experiences its steepest drop between destination click and application start, while Android devices show consistently higher passport capture failure rates linked to the April 2026 passport scan model update.

insights.headline: Overall headline conversion rate is 0.71% across 1 million visitor sessions
insights.detail: The platform recorded 1,000,000 unique destination card clicks and 7,054 completed purchases, yielding an overall headline conversion rate of 0.71% over the observed time window.
insights.why: Establishes the core platform baseline for visitor-to-purchase volume against which deeper funnel stages and drop-offs are measured.
insights.recommendation: Track daily variations against this 0.71% baseline when deploying new funnel updates or marketing campaigns.

insights.headline: Daily destination card clicks exhibit consistent periodic volume fluctuations between 3,600 and 4,800 clicks
insights.detail: Daily unique user clicks on destination cards range from a low of 3,689 on January 7, 2026, to a peak of 4,783 on January 15, 2026, showing regular cyclical dips every 6 to 7 days.
insights.why: Reflects standard weekly seasonality in travel intent and browsing patterns rather than systemic technical interruptions.
insights.recommendation: Account for weekly cyclicality when evaluating short-term campaign performance or traffic dips.

insights.headline: The steepest funnel drop-off occurs between destination card clicks and application starts
insights.detail: Out of 1,000,000 initial destination card clicks, only 154,413 users proceed to start an application (a step-through rate of 15.4%), representing an absolute loss of 845,587 users.
insights.why: Users browse destination requirements or card info casually without high immediate intent to apply, which is inherent to the discovery phase of a travel platform.
insights.recommendation: Focus optimization efforts on high-intent entry points and explore re-engagement mechanics like the WhatsApp nudge to capture browsing drop-offs.

insights.headline: Android passport upload pass rates underperform iOS by up to 8 percentage points
insights.detail: Android camera uploads achieve an 83.6% pass rate with 0.47 average retries compared to 91.3% pass rate and 0.46 average retries on iOS camera uploads across 9,598 total document uploads.
insights.why: Coincides with the documented April 2026 passport scan model update which introduced higher capture failure rates across Android devices.
insights.recommendation: Review the Android passport capture model weights and error thresholds deployed in April 2026 to reduce scan failures.

insights.headline: Android users in Singapore and Great Britain experience the highest passport capture threshold failure rates
insights.detail: Android users in Singapore (SG) experience a 22.2% failure rate crossing the failed-attempt threshold (20 failures out of 90 uploads), while Great Britain (GB) Android users see an 18.2% failure rate.
insights.why: Amplified by a combination of the Android passport scan model update and potential higher prevalence of non-Latin MRZ or local document variations in international hubs.
context_refs: K3 MRZ OCR weaker on non-Latin passports
insights.recommendation: Audit passport capture logs for Singapore and GB Android traffic to isolate whether device model or document type drives the elevated threshold failures.

queries.question: What is the overall headline conversion rate measured as completed purchases per unique session, alongside total event counts across the core funnel stages?
queries.sql: SELECT uniqExact(app_session_id) AS total_sessions, (SELECT uniqExact(app_session_id) FROM atlys.purchase_completed) AS total_purchases, (SELECT uniqExact(app_session_id) FROM atlys.purchase_completed) / nullIf(uniqExact(app_session_id), 0) AS overall_conversion_rate FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked

queries.question: What is the daily trend of destination card clicks and completed purchases over time?
queries.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS dt, uniqExact(user_id) AS destination_clicks FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the step-through conversion rate and drop-off per funnel stage across different device types?
queries.sql: SELECT device_type, uniqExact(user_id) AS clicks FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the destination card click and purchase volume broken down by geographic country code?
queries.sql: SELECT geoip_country_code, uniqExact(user_id) AS unique_visitors, count() AS total_clicks FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked GROUP BY geoip_country_code ORDER BY total_clicks DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the step-to-step user count and conversion ratio across the sequential funnel stages from destination click to purchase completion?
queries.sql: SELECT '1_click' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.destination_card_clicked UNION ALL SELECT '2_app_started' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.application_started UNION ALL SELECT '3_doc_uploaded' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.document_uploaded UNION ALL SELECT '4_purchase_completed' AS stage, uniqExact(user_id) AS users FROM atlys.purchase_completed

queries.question: What is the passport-capture pass rate and average retry count broken down by device OS and capture mode?
queries.sql: SELECT os, capture_mode, count() AS total_uploads, countIf(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 0) / count() AS pass_rate, avg(retry_count) AS avg_retries FROM atlys.document_uploaded GROUP BY os, capture_mode ORDER BY total_uploads DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What cross-dimensional anomaly patterns exist between device types and geographic countries regarding failed passport capture attempts?
queries.sql: SELECT device_type, geoip_country_code, count() AS uploads, countIf(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 1) AS failed_threshold_count, countIf(is_crossed_failed_attempt_threshold = 1) / count() AS failure_rate FROM atlys.document_uploaded GROUP BY device_type, geoip_country_code HAVING uploads > 5 ORDER BY failure_rate DESC LIMIT 20

queries.question: What is the distribution of retry counts during document uploads across different devices and operating systems using quantiles?
queries.sql: SELECT device_type, os, quantile(0.5)(retry_count) AS p50_retries, quantile(0.95)(retry_count) AS p95_retries FROM atlys.document_uploaded GROUP BY device_type, os ORDER BY p95_retries DESC LIMIT 20
